title: Pig waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='pigBody' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb6c1'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f28aa0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='snout' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fa3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e06b85'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- left ear -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='24' rx='10' ry='13' fill='#f59ab0'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='24' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#e07f97'/>

  <!-- right ear -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='24' rx='10' ry='13' fill='#f59ab0'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='24' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#e07f97'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='24' fill='url(#pigBody)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#ffd0da'/>

  <!-- left leg -->
  <rect x='34' y='88' width='11' height='10' rx='4' fill='#f28aa0'/>
  <ellipse cx='39.5' cy='97' rx='5.5' ry='3' fill='#e07f97'/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <rect x='55' y='88' width='11' height='10' rx='4' fill='#f28aa0'/>
  <ellipse cx='60.5' cy='97' rx='5.5' ry='3' fill='#e07f97'/>

  <!-- left arm down -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='66' rx='7' ry='10' transform='rotate(20 26 66)' fill='#f28aa0'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='75' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ffd0da'/>

  <!-- right arm waving up -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='46' rx='7' ry='13' transform='rotate(-25 76 46)' fill='#f28aa0'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='34' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ffd0da'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='24' ry='21' fill='url(#pigBody)'/>

  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='13' ry='9' fill='url(#snout)'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#8e3b52'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#8e3b52'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='36' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#5a2a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='34' rx='1.3' ry='1.6' fill='#ffe9ee'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='36' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#5a2a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='34' rx='1.3' ry='1.6' fill='#ffe9ee'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='46' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9fb4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='46' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9fb4' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M45 59 Q50 63 55 59' stroke='#8e3b52' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
